description_en: Queries user operation records for API security of Web Application Firewall (WAF)
description_zh: 查询API安全用户操作记录
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-apisec-user-operations --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-wwo36ksck1e --object-id fe8723e92e2037245014ab62161bbec8 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeApisecUserOperations

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the operation record. Valid values:

abnormal: threat detection.

event: security event
parameters.help_zh:
操作记录类型，取值：
abnormal：表示风险检测。
event：表示安全事件
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the threat detection or security event for which you want to query operation records
parameters.name: object_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Hybrid Cloud WAF cluster.

This parameter is required only when WAF is deployed in hybrid cloud mode. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html operation to query the IDs of Hybrid Cloud WAF clusters
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group to which the WAF instance belongs
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Data.description_en: The user operation records for API security

items.description_en: The details of the operation record

FromStatus.description_en:
The status of the threat detection or security event before the operation was performed.

Valid values for threat detection:

toBeConfirmed: to be confirmed.

confirmed: confirmed.

toBeFixed: to be fixed.

fixed: fixed.

ignored: ignored.

Valid values for a security event:

toBeConfirmed: to be confirmed.

confirmed: confirmed.

ignored: ignored
FromStatus.description_zh:
操作前状态。

风险（risk）状态，取值：
toBeConfirmed：表示待确认。
confirmed：表示已确认。
toBeFixed：表示待修复。
fixed：表示已修复。
ignored：表示忽略。

事件（event）状态，取值：
toBeConfirmed：表示待确认。
confirmed：表示已确认。
ignored：表示忽略

Note.description_en: The remarks that the user added to the operation record

ObjectId.description_en: The ID of the threat detection or security event associated with the operation record

OperationSource.description_en:
The source of the operation. Valid values:

system: the operation was automatically performed by the system.

custom: the operation was manually performed by a user
OperationSource.description_zh:
操作的来源。 取值：
system：表示系统操作。
custom：表示用户操作

Time.description_en: The time when the operation was performed. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
Time.description_zh: 操作时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒

ToStatus.description_en:
The status of the threat detection or security event after the operation was performed.

Valid values for threat detection:

toBeConfirmed: to be confirmed.

confirmed: confirmed.

toBeFixed: to be fixed.

fixed: fixed.

ignored: ignored.

Valid values for a security event:

toBeConfirmed: to be confirmed.

confirmed: confirmed.

ignored: ignored
ToStatus.description_zh:
操作后状态。

风险（risk）状态，取值：
toBeConfirmed：表示待确认。
confirmed：表示已确认。
toBeFixed：表示待修复。
fixed：表示已修复。
ignored：表示忽略。

事件（event）状态，取值：
toBeConfirmed：表示待确认。
confirmed：表示已确认。
ignored：表示忽略

Type.description_en:
The type of the operation record. Valid values:

abnormal: threat detection.

event: security event
Type.description_zh:
操作记录类型，取值：
abnormal：表示风险检测。
event：表示安全事件

UserId.description_en: The ID of the user who performed the operation
